notes.title: Online features have been changed to use the Steam network
notes.content:
1.Based on player feedback, considering the stability of the network, the online function has been changed to use the Steam network.
2.Fix some bugs

notes.title: Journey Into Darkness EA Stage Update Preview
notes.content:
Thank you for your support, the game is currently in the EA stage and there is still a lot of content that is not perfect.
We are continuing to develop and improve the content.

Below is a list of our upcoming updates:

Improve the in-game guide to make the gameplay more intuitive and natural.
Improve current levels (e.g. add plot content, etc.)
Develop levels for chapter 2, as well as new online play.


The above will be updated over the next few months, thank you.
